# NEXAFLOW

> NEXAFLOW is a new Nepal company that sets up WhatsApp and AI automation for bakeries, cafes, restaurants, hotels and shops: instant replies to customer questions, order taking, bookings, review requests and daily reports, in English, Nepali and Romanized Nepali. A real person can take over any chat at any time. Based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Owner: Rejin Karki.

## Main pages
- [Home (English)](https://nexaflownp.com/): what NEXAFLOW does, how it works, packages and FAQ
- [Home (Nepali)](https://nexaflownp.com/ne/): the same in Nepali
- [Portfolio](https://nexaflownp.com/portfolio/): what we build, sample chats, how we work
- [Privacy policy](https://nexaflownp.com/privacy/): what the site collects and why

## What we do
- WhatsApp auto-replies for menu, hours, location and delivery questions
- Order taking and table, room or appointment bookings
- Instagram and Facebook inbox replies
- Offers and festival messages to customers who agreed to receive them
- Review and feedback requests, stock alerts and daily reports
- Custom automation for other repeat jobs

## Facts
- Packages: Starter, Growth and Full automation. Prices are quoted after a short free call.
- Languages: English, Nepali and Romanized Nepali.
- Contact: use the form at https://nexaflownp.com/#contact
